title: Digital Integrated Circuits
tagline: CMOS inverters and gates, timing, interconnect, power and memory design
summary: Billions of transistors on a chip behave as logic gates only because of careful circuit design. This course analyses the CMOS inverter and logic gates, delay and logical effort, dynamic and sequential circuits, interconnect, power dissipation and memory arrays, together with the fabrication process and layout.

chapters.title: CMOS fabrication and layout
chapters.summary: The CMOS process, layers and masks, design rules, stick diagrams and layout.

chapters.title: The CMOS inverter
chapters.summary: Voltage transfer characteristic, noise margins, switching threshold, propagation delay and sizing.

chapters.title: Static CMOS logic
chapters.summary: Complementary gates, transistor sizing, logical effort, and pass-transistor and transmission-gate logic.

chapters.title: Dynamic logic
chapters.summary: Precharge–evaluate circuits, domino logic, charge sharing and leakage.

chapters.title: Sequential circuits and clocking
chapters.summary: CMOS latches and flip-flops, timing constraints, clock distribution, skew and jitter.

chapters.title: Interconnect
chapters.summary: Resistance, capacitance and inductance of wires, Elmore delay, repeaters and crosstalk.

chapters.title: Power dissipation
chapters.summary: Dynamic, short-circuit and leakage power, voltage scaling, clock gating and power gating.

chapters.title: Memory arrays
chapters.summary: SRAM, DRAM and flash cells, sense amplifiers, decoders and memory organisation.
